instruction:
Three Storey Courtyard Hostel Replacement IFC

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. Replace the starting hotel layout with a three-storey hostel layout and save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 21 IfcSpace entities, 24 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcStair.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token bedroom at least 20 times and lounge at least once.
7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name shared lounge at least once.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
